name: tree-seats-across
description: seat.json's sixteen spruces seen across the edge they stand on, from the low side 3 m off (the flat beside the tread, the cutting's bed), the eye 1.6 m over the ground there, looking at the foot: the face the rim hangs over is between the camera and the trunk. A marker a tree.
